name: Scoring
title: Lead scoring
description: Models that rate records as cold, warm or hot by adding up profile and behavior points.
help: The primary model of each type shows in the Score field of lists and records. Scores are recalculated whenever a record changes and once a day.

empty.title: No scoring models
empty.description: Create a model to prioritize the most engaged records.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.bandsHint: Below Warm the score is Cold.
dialog.criteriaHint: Criteria add or remove points from the record's score.
dialog.noCriteria: Add at least one criterion for the model to score.
dialog.pointsHint: Use negative values to remove points.

errors.invalidKey: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.points: Enter a non-zero integer between -1000 and 1000.
errors.decay: Enter a number of days between 1 and 3650.
errors.bands: Must be greater than the start of the warm band.
errors.filter: Add at least one condition to the filter.

kindHints.profile: Adds the points while the record matches the filter.
kindHints.behavior: Adds the points on each occurrence, up to the limit. Each occurrence loses value until it reaches zero after the decay days.

dialog.primaryHint: Shows in the Score field of lists and records.
dialog.activeHint: Inactive models do not calculate scores.
dialog.bandsPreview: Cold: below {{warm}} · Warm: {{warm}} to {{warmEnd}} · Hot: {{hot}} or more

removeDialog.title: Delete scoring model
removeDialog.description: The model {{name}} and every score calculated by it will be removed.

toasts.created: Model created. Scores will be calculated shortly.
toasts.conflict: Someone else changed the model. Close and open it again to edit.
toasts.error: The model could not be saved.

record.empty: No active scoring model for this record type.

create.title: New scoring model
create.description: Give it a name and choose the record type. You set the criteria and bands on the next screen.

edit.modelDescription: Name, description and status of the model.
edit.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list of models.
